metrics.method: Full history 2025-08-25 to 2026-09-11: 1826 non-service messages (1086 client / 740 our side, vendor 'Lauryn chat team' counted as our side). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?'. Strict first-reply-by-anyone lag is excellent (median 0.03h, mean 1.6h, p90 3.2h) and produces only 1 breach over 24h; unanswered_over_24h=4 instead counts client questions with no SUBSTANTIVE answer inside 24h, grouping repeat nudges on one topic as one item: invoice split 2026-07-19 (43h); Zelle-email-not-working 2026-08-07 (39h); 'What our update?' 2026-08-13 after Vivek's broken 2-hour promise; and the Facebook chase thread of 2026-09-02/03 ('Any updates???' / 'We still in review ??' / '???'), which is still unanswered 8 days later and is now permanent. max_team_silence_days = longest run with zero human outbound from our side, excluding automated leak-scan broadcasts (9.6d, 2025-12-05 to 2025-12-15); raw longest gap including broadcasts is 8.1d. At window close the human-outbound silence stands at 4.7 days (last non-broadcast message 2026-09-06), spanning two unacknowledged payments. Promises = explicit dated commitments made by our side; 2 further promises were unverifiable from the transcript and are excluded from kept/lapsed.

top_fix: Give every account one named owner who is accountable for a dated status on every open issue and a stats report every two weeks, make a written handover to the client mandatory whenever any staffer or vendor team leaves, and never send an invoice without that report attached. Lauryn lost her relationship manager silently on 2025-10-09 and her entire chat team silently on 2026-06-10; from those two moments nobody owned her numbers, no report was ever sent again, the Facebook block ran a full year unresolved, and the only contact she had left with us was an invoice chase — which is why, twelve months in, we are billing her for 'our team on your page' while no team has spoken on the account in 93 days, and why she has now paid us twice into total silence.
